cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A professionally corrects physical seating and private assent as incomplete handover steps until B publicly names A decision-maker.
confusable: D57 could request title respect; D60 must establish A authority to decide through B public declaration.
comparison: Hall alternative uses an actual event question; meeting alternative insists the departing chair address the room rather than A alone.
seedUse: Meeting departure, occupied chair, furniture and private acknowledgement derive from D60-b; S03 makes stepwise corrections explicit.
